questions.question: What is macroeconomics?
options: The study of the economy as a whole

questions.question: What is GDP?
options: Gross Domestic Product - the total value of goods and services produced

questions.question: What is inflation?
options: A general increase in prices over time
A decrease in prices over time

questions.question: What is unemployment?
options: The percentage of the labor force that is jobless and seeking work
The total number of people without jobs
The number of people who don't want to work

questions.question: What is fiscal policy?
options: Government spending and taxation to influence the economy
Central bank control of money supply

questions.question: What is monetary policy?
options: Central bank control of money supply and interest rates

questions.question: What is aggregate demand?
options: Total demand for goods and services in an economy

questions.question: What is aggregate supply?
options: Total supply of goods and services in an economy

questions.question: What is a recession?
options: A significant decline in economic activity

questions.question: What is the business cycle?
options: Fluctuations in economic activity over time
The cycle of buying and selling

questions.question: What is the multiplier effect?
options: The magnified impact of initial spending on total income
The effect of inflation on prices
The effect of unemployment on wages
The effect of taxes on spending

questions.question: What is the Phillips Curve?
options: The relationship between unemployment and inflation
The relationship between GDP and inflation
The relationship between interest rates and inflation
The relationship between money supply and inflation

questions.question: What is the natural rate of unemployment?
options: The unemployment rate that exists when the economy is at full employment

questions.question: What is stagflation?
options: High inflation combined with high unemployment

questions.question: What is the velocity of money?
options: The rate at which money circulates in the economy
